keyword: LZ-60 and LZ-80 same dimensions different engine

title.en: The Shared 6.6 m Outline Does Not Choose LZ-60 or LZ-80
title.zh: 共享的 6.6 米外形选不出 LZ-60 或 LZ-80

description.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai prints 6.6 × 1.8 × 1.9 m on both LZ-60 and LZ-80. Engines are 145 kW and Yuchai 256 kW. Weights are 5500 kg and 6800 kg.
description.zh: 河北品锦机械在邢台把 6.6 × 1.8 × 1.9 m 同时印在 LZ-60 和 LZ-80 上。发动机是 145 kW 和玉柴 256 kW。重量是 5500 kg 和 6800 kg。

h1.en: Name the Engine After the LZ Outline Matches
h1.zh: LZ 外形对上之后还要点明发动机

directAnswer.en: A measured outline of 6.6 × 1.8 × 1.9 m still leaves two diesel pages at Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai. LZ-60 is 6105 / 145 kW, 50 m³/h, 35 MPa, conveying 100 m, height 300 m, pipe 100 / 125 mm and 5500 kg. LZ-80 is Yuchai 256 kW, with high and low pressure modes, conveying 120 m, hopper 0.6 m³ and 6800 kg, and its delivery height says consult the factory standard. The order must name the engine and, for LZ-80, the mode. Send one path to [/en/contact/](/en/contact/). No price is printed.
directAnswer.zh: 量到外形 6.6 × 1.8 × 1.9 m，在河北品锦机械（邢台）仍然留下两张柴油页。LZ-60 是 6105 / 145 kW、50 m³/h、35 MPa、输送距离 100 m、高度 300 m、管径 100 / 125 mm、5500 kg。LZ-80 是玉柴 256 kW，带高压和低压模式，输送距离 120 m，料斗 0.6 m³，6800 kg，输送高度写的是咨询工厂标准。订单必须点明发动机，对 LZ-80 还要点明模式。把一条路径发到 [/zh/contact/](/zh/contact/)。没有印价格。

heading.en: Do not convert the metres in silence

body.en: Quote 6.6 × 1.8 × 1.9 m as printed, and add the weight of the path you mean.
body.zh: 按印出的 6.6 × 1.8 × 1.9 m 引用，并加上你所指路径的重量。

heading.zh: 管径是 LZ-60 的格子

body.en: 100 / 125 mm is on LZ-60. The LZ-80 list used here does not print that pipe. Do not share it across the outline.
body.zh: 100 / 125 mm 在 LZ-60 上。此处使用的 LZ-80 列表不印这根管子。不要顺着外形共享过去。

body.en: Diesel 120 prints 7000 × 2000 × 2300 mm and 8000 kg. It is not this outline.

question.en: Can one inquiry ask for both?
question.zh: 一封询盘可以问两台吗？

answer.en: Yes, if each path stays separate. Xingtai prices a path, not the outline alone.
answer.zh: 可以，只要每条路径保持分开。邢台按路径报价，而不是只按外形。
